name: MTH 323 256 MAX (MTH, 256 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".750". No method mark: method not stated. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".366est.". Marked est.: estimated, within +/- 5% (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 2, MTH-Match, Tactical, Hunting: Caliber .323 (8mm), Grains 256, Minimum Required Twist *1-9", Part Number MTH 323 256 MAX, G1 BC .750, G7 BC .366est., OAL 1.882", Bullet Projection 1.317"
